intro.heading: Hokkaido's seasonal flavors, in true onsen ryokan style
description: Seafood landed on the shores of Lake Toya, and seasonal vegetables from around Hokkaido. Enjoy a relaxed Japanese kaiseki course that makes the most of each ingredient, in a calm setting.
We incorporate seasonal ingredients throughout the year, serving hot dishes hot. It's mealtime the way only an onsen ryokan can offer.

dinner.heading: Dinner
description: For dinner, choose from two kaiseki course plans featuring seasonal ingredients.
Both plans use seasonal ingredients from around Lake Toya and across Hokkaido, with hot dishes served hot.
dinner.comparisonNote: If you'd like to enjoy the flavors of seafood and vegetables in a hot pot, we recommend the Yosenabe Kaiseki Course. If you prefer a heartier, meat-centered meal, try the Chef's Choice Japanese Kaiseki Course (shabu-shabu). You can choose your preferred plan when booking.

plans.name: Yosenabe Kaiseki Course
description: A kaiseki course centered on a hot pot generously filled with seafood and vegetables, showcasing seasonal flavors.
A dish that warms you from the core — a winter favorite that only an onsen ryokan can offer.
plans.recommendedFor: Those who want a lighter meal centered on seafood and vegetables
plans.seasonalNote: The menu may change depending on the season and available ingredients.

plans.name: Chef's Choice Japanese Kaiseki Course
description: A kaiseki course centered on shabu-shabu made with select pork shoulder loin, served with seasonal appetizers and grilled dishes.
Enjoy this classic yet indulgent dish, with its sweet-savory dipping sauce and egg.
plans.recommendedFor: Those who want a hearty, meat-centered meal
plans.seasonalNote: The menu may change depending on the season and available ingredients.

breakfast.heading: Breakfast
description: For breakfast, we offer one Japanese-style set centered on grilled fish, small side dishes, and freshly cooked rice.
Start your day gently with food that's easy on the body.

plan.name: Japanese Breakfast
description: We prepare a Japanese breakfast that's gentle on the body, featuring grilled fish, small side dishes, freshly cooked rice, and miso soup.
Start your morning with a warm meal and ease into the day.
plan.seasonalNote: Contents may change depending on the season and available ingredients.

diningVenues.heading: Dining Venues

inRoom.heading: In-Room Dining
description: Enjoy a relaxed meal in the privacy of your own room, without worrying about those around you.
A calm setting perfect for family trips or couples' getaways.
inRoom.note: Depending on the number of guests or group size, a private dining room may be used instead.

hall.heading: Banquet Hall Dining
description: Enjoy your meal alongside other guests in our Japanese-style banquet hall.
Have dinner and breakfast in an atmosphere that only an onsen ryokan can offer.
hall.note: Some plans serve both dinner and breakfast in the banquet hall.

planNote: Depending on your stay plan, meals will be served either in your room or in the banquet hall.
Please check each stay plan for details.

guestConsiderations.heading: Allergy Accommodations
guestConsiderations.description: If you have any food allergies, please let us know in advance. We will accommodate you where possible.

guestConsiderations.heading: Families Welcome
guestConsiderations.description: Families with children can stay with peace of mind. Please contact us in advance about children's meals or chairs.
